ValidationRule.description: Validate Account Email Address lenght is not longer than 60 characters
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Administrador do sistema', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Master Data")), LEN( PMC_DH_Email__c ) > 60 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Email Address should not exceed 60 characters.
